_doc: Milford's real road surface along the lap from the 2017 lidar (road_profile_lidar.py profile). Every height is a robust plane's constant term through the class-2 returns within the disc (wavy_survey's read). z_m in the built frame: lidar z + datum_m - origin.elev_m (the G10 surface read's y_m datum, the deck's +0.10 inside). Measured unless marked [invented] / [model] / [inferred].

line.what: the build's swept line (the assembler's line; the ribbon is +-w/2 about it). The driven lane is this centre line: ai/full/ai_draft.json is a generated centreline draft (offset_max 0.016 m), not a racing line

inputs.lidar: USGS 3DEP USGS_LPC_MI_31Co_Oakland_2016_LAS_2019 (flown 2017), EPT nodes at full depth: the ring read (2026-11-22) then the lap corridor read (mf_lidar), union by node key

frame.xz: ENU local metres (x east, z north) about origin; the lidar moved by shift_m (dE, dN) into it
frame.s: metres along the line from its first point, n = round(lap / 0.5) equal steps
frame.offset_sign: + = left of travel: point = (x, z) + offset * (nx, nz)

registration.source: track.config.json terrain.lidar_shift_m (ledger 0102) = the measured surface's registration_lidar_shift_m (source/surface/road_surface_gm.fit.json), measured by the G10 on 0.1.11's built OBJ (2026-11-13) and carried by the GM read; datum_m = that read's built - lidar on the centre path

constants.disc_note: the 1.25 m disc averages the surface over ~2.5 m: the 2-30 m band's short end is attenuated (a 2.5 m wave reads about half its height) [model]

noise.noise_m: cal x fit_sd / sqrt(kept returns) (the G10 read's model; its GM read measured cal 1.435)
noise.split_half_m: |A - B| / 2, A and B planes through alternate returns (each >= 6), where measurable

strips.by: point_source_id (each a single pass: its GPS times span ~13 s)
strips.own_profiles_doc: per strip and path, where the disc holds >= STRIP_MIN_N of its kept returns: z_m = the merged plane + the strip's mean residual about it (its level, on the merged plane's tilt; where it covers alone, the merged profile itself); se_m its standard error; own_plane_z_m = the strip's independent plane (>= 6 of its returns) where its constant's SE from the returns' geometry is <= OWN_PLANE_SE_M [invented] (at the swath's edge 6-8 returns can lie along one scan line, and the independent plane runs away: up to 0.42 m seen before this gate)

constant.held: the strips' point-weighted mean at 0 (weights: each strip's returns near the lap)

linear_gps_time.note: a = offset at the strip's mean GPS time near the lap, b = its drift per second; a tiny ridge on b [invented] picks the min-norm answer where two slopes trade

-0.8.60-120 m: zone shorter than 2 x 120 m: not measured

+0.0.60-120 m: zone shorter than 2 x 120 m: not measured

+0.8.60-120 m: zone shorter than 2 x 120 m: not measured

verdict_strips._doc: survives = the levelled profile's band RMS over the merged's, per 100 m window (100 % = the strip offsets carry none of it); removed = the RMS of (merged - levelled) in the band. The strips' own along-track errors that do NOT differ between the two strips cannot be seen here; those that do show in the overlap offset's band, against its noise [model]. Away from the overlaps one strip covers the road alone, and levelling cannot change its band at all (a constant per strip)

built._doc: the build's own road profile on the same paths, from committed files only (no mesh): fit = the measured-surface product's plane c + u b (tools/measured_surface.py Product.at by position; the deck's +0.10 inside c, the lidar profiles' datum) + the banked turn's section delta (route.densify.section: spans of the product's s, smoothstep taper); line = the line file's own Y + deck + u tan(bank) (crossfall file) + the same delta: the intake wrote Y = the fit at the assembler's smoothed points - the deck, so the two should agree (lap_wide.fit_minus_line_m; z_m is the fit's). built minus real per window: each metric's difference, and the RMS of (built - real) in the band

control._doc: road_profile_lidar.py control: this script's plane at the G10 GM surface read's own centre-path points (that read is board asset 7da6810244a541615b95aced5f6e5290, the one tools/measured_surface.py fit made road_surface_gm.fit.json from), within 1.5 m of this line
